story: Red Rock State Park covers 286 acres of Arizona, featuring a red sandstone canyon near Sedona. The park includes a stretch of Oak Creek and serves as an environmental education facility.
matters: The rich riparian zone along the creek supports a diverse array of species, including rare native fish and the threatened Sonora mud turtle. Lower Oak Creek has been designated an Important Bird Area.
name: Red Rock State Park
